input:
And the unexpected interface changes — last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week.
Unexpected interface changes disrupt work and require unplanned retraining.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest payments report for our policyholders, and it’s holding up our month-end close.
The user cannot retrieve the latest payments report, delaying month‑end close.

We’ve got a reporting deadline next week, so getting this sorted quickly would really ease the pressure.
The customer needs a fast fix because a reporting deadline is approaching.

Morning Bryn, we’ve got a couple of claims held up because the approver’s out and there’s no backup — the approval waiting list is piling up.
Claims get delayed because the designated approver is unavailable and there is no backup.

we’re getting blocked trying to log into Keelwater again this morning. It’s showing ‘down’ but I think it’s on our end.
The user cannot log into Keelwater because the system shows it is down.

That would really help — we’re also onboarding Wexmoor Motor at the same? ... consistency matters a lot.
Ensuring consistency while onboarding multiple clients simultaneously.

We’re really pushing for automatic claim progress messages to go out via SMS and email to policyholders at each milestone — it’s a big gap for us right now.
The platform does not currently send automatic claim progress updates to policyholders via SMS and email.

Yes, please — and include reporting and letters too. We need full visibility across all touchpoints.
The customer lacks comprehensive visibility across all touchpoints, including reporting and letters.

We’re seeing some issues with how claims get assigned and docs get filed — can we talk it through?
The customer is experiencing problems with how claims are assigned and how documents are filed.

can we turn off auto‑routing for our commercial claims? They’re too complex.
The auto‑routing feature cannot handle the complexity of commercial claims.

I was wondering if there’s a way to use ... keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry — it’d save us a lot of time during busy periods.
The user cannot use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes, making data entry slower.

we’re not expecting any supplier invoices on this one, so no need to flag those.
The customer needs to ensure no supplier invoices are flagged for a specific claim.

we’re still manually calling garages because the system doesn’t show live repair updates, which eats up half our morning.
The team has to call garages manually because the platform lacks live repair updates, wasting a large part of their morning.

We’re under pressure to improve policyholder communication, and claim progress messages are key for us right now.
The company needs better communication with policyholders about claim progress.

Every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it, which delays claims resolution.
Garage estimate documents are automatically placed in the wrong category, causing handlers to miss key evidence and delay claim resolution.

we’re seeing a mismatch between what’s shown on the MI dashboard and the figures we get when exporting CSVs — it’s causing some confusion in finance.
The data shown on the MI dashboard does not match the numbers in exported CSV files, leading to confusion.

I’m still waiting on those automatic claim progress messages for policyholders — we were told Q1 next year, but it’s dragging and handlers are fielding repeat calls.
Customers are not receiving the promised automatic claim progress messages, leading to delays and repeat calls from policyholders.

the multiple file upload feature isn’t as smooth as we’d hoped — they’re having to upload documents one at a time still, which slows things down.
Staff must upload claim documents one by one, making the multiple file upload process slow and clunky.

Can you walk me through how to assign roles to new claims handlers in the dashboard?
The user does not know how to assign roles to new claims handlers in the dashboard.

we’ll keep chasing them by phone — just wish it wasn’t part of our daily workflow.
The team has to manually chase claim updates by phone, making it a burdensome daily task.

Actually, there’s one thing — when a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there.
Reserve changes that exceed a handler's approval limit get stuck in the system.

Perfect — appreciate the thoroughness.
The customer needed more detailed and thorough claim summaries.

It’s a small thing but causes delays in handling claims properly.
Claims documents are automatically placed in the wrong category, causing handling delays.

any update on the reserve calculation logic? We need it aligned with our reporting standards.
The reserve calculation logic does not match the customer's reporting standards.

we can pull full audit logs for admin review — it’s becoming urgent for our compliance team. We really need the audit-log export for admins to meet our internal compliance deadlines — it’s not just a nice-to-have anymore.
The platform does not allow pulling full audit logs for admin review, jeopardizing compliance deadlines.

Yes, please — and while we’re at it, can you clarify how the pricing tiers handle integrations with third-party repair networks? Just to confirm, the annual license fee still includes unlimited document uploads and supplier integrations, right?
The customer is unsure whether the current pricing tiers cover integrations with third‑party repair networks and unlimited document uploads.

We’re also struggling with supplier comms and task tracking — it’s all tied together.
Difficulty managing supplier communications and tracking tasks.

we’d really appreciate fewer surprises and more notice before any major shifts in how we access claims or documents.
Unexpected changes to access to claims or documents cause surprise.

Payments: click "Overview", dead x1
The user cannot proceed because the Payments overview page is broken.

That’d help — send it over. Also, can we schedule a follow-up to discuss task automation and letter templates?
The customer needs to receive a document and arrange a meeting to discuss automation and templates.

I need to reset my password for the Keelwater portal — I’ve forgotten it and can’t log in to review claims or update reserves.
Forgotten password blocks access to the portal.

Hi Alwen, thanks for setting this up — we’re keen to see how Keelwater handles our claim workflows this quarter.
The customer wants to evaluate Keelwater's claim workflow handling for the upcoming quarter.

I’ve been reviewing our claims handling workflows and need clarity on how your system manages reserves and supplier payments together.
The customer is unclear about how the system handles reserves and supplier payments together.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception
The user gets an error exception when trying to export a CSV from the Reports page.

Tasks: click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
The user must click multiple buttons, leading to frustration.

any way to automate that in Keelwater?
They need to automate scheduling of regular reviews for reserves and supplier payments.

just wanted to flag a few things we’ve run into since going live — nothing critical, but they’re slowing us down a bit.
Minor issues after going live are slowing the team down.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception...Reports: click "Next"
Exporting a report to CSV fails with an error.

I’m trying to update our team’s access levels and I’m stuck on assigning roles for new staff.
The user cannot assign roles to new staff when updating access levels.

They’re not happy with the new figures, and it’s becoming a recurring theme.
High-value accounts are unhappy with renewal price increases.

how are tasks assigned when a claim hits a threshold that requires manual review?
Uncertainty about how tasks are assigned for claims needing manual review.

Appreciate that — we need to avoid any more delays in payments or supplier settlements.
Payments and supplier settlements are being delayed.

We’ve been trying to use the bulk ... but it’s still not handling upload files together reliably — we ... get timeouts on batches over 50 documents.
Bulk uploads time out when processing large batches of documents.

Can you walk me through how to attach supporting documents to a claims file in the system?
The user does not know how to attach supporting documents to a claims file.

Hi Bryn, I’m Dovren from Brantwick Commercial. We’ve got a few claims needing urgent attention and I’m not sure how to allocate the tasks correctly.
The user is unsure how to correctly assign tasks for several urgent claims.

No delegate at all — and it’s causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before we can process payments.
The lack of a delegate causes delays in reserve updates that require sign‑off before payments can be processed.

We’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates.
Claim progress updates are sent manually, causing delays and missed communications.

Exactly. That’s the problem — no warning, no link option, just two claims.
The system provides no warning or link option, only showing two claims.

Also, your interface changes lately — controls moving without warning — it’s forcing us to retrain staff constantly.
Unexpected interface changes force staff to be retrained repeatedly.

Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual ... control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing.
The team needs both automatic routing by postcode and manual control for complex cases, causing a conflict.

It’s the commercial fleet group — the one with the updated roles assigned last week. I’ve double-checked the permissions and they look correct.
The user cannot retrieve data for the commercial fleet group despite correct permissions.

Great. And just to confirm — does the system allow us to set up custom reporting dashboards for our internal teams?
Uncertainty about the platform's ability to create custom reporting dashboards for internal teams.

it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions
The platform is delaying payments, causing supplier concerns.

we’re seeing ... pushback from policyholders on renewal pricing — it’s hitting our top accounts hardest.
Policyholders are pushing back on renewal pricing, especially affecting top accounts.

It’s a real drag — every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow to phone suppliers because repair updates missing means no visibility.
Missing repair updates force the team to stop their work and call suppliers for information.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for a high-value marine claim, and it’s holding up our payment cycle.
The user cannot pull the latest reserves report for a high‑value marine claim, delaying payments.

Exactly — we’re drowning in supplier invoices and policyholder letters, and our reporting is all over the place.
The team is overwhelmed by manual supplier invoices and policyholder letters, and their reporting is disorganized.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to reconcile the reserves for our latest batch of claims but the system isn’t pulling through the supplier payments correctly — any idea what might be causing that?
The system fails to pull supplier payments correctly during reserve reconciliation.

We’re drowning in repair updates missing again this week — it’s eating into our daily tasks. We’re stuck calling garages every day because repair updates missing — it’s a constant drag on our team’s productivity and delays claim resolution.
Repair updates are frequently missing, forcing the team to manually chase garages and slowing claim resolution.

Appreciate the quick response. We’ve double-checked the roles and tasks assigned — everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week.
The reported numbers are incorrect and do not match the data they submitted last week.

we’re having trouble pulling updated reserves for our high-value claims this morning
They cannot retrieve the latest reserve amounts for high-value claims.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard to upload documents.
The user cannot log in to the claims dashboard because they have forgotten their password.

Hi Deryn, just checking in — we’ve got a few things we need to sort before renewal, and one’s become pretty urgent.
The customer needs to address several items before renewal, and one has become urgent.

Could you walk me through how to upload supporting documents for a claim? I keep getting stuck at the supplier validation step.
The user cannot complete the upload of supporting documents because they get stuck at the supplier validation step.
